distribution.narrative: The Taiwan report was based on Shiraki specimens; Beaver & Liu (2010) noted frequent confusion with Ips subelongatus and did not confirm I. cembrae from Taiwan.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips cembrae (Heer, 1836).
